interpretations.plain_english_summary: The House voted on ordering the previous question for H. Res. 161, a procedural step tied to floor consideration of energy-related disapproval resolutions and a budget resolution.
interpretations.what_happened: The House voted on whether to order the previous question for H. Res. 161.
interpretations.why_it_mattered: The vote affected whether the House moved forward procedurally toward adopting the rule for considering the listed measures.
interpretations.member_vote_context: This candidate explains the procedural vote only. It does not map a member's Yea or Nay to support or opposition on the underlying resolutions.
interpretations.what_not_to_infer: Do not treat this as final passage of H.J. Res. 20, H.J. Res. 35, or H. Con. Res. 14, or as a direct policy position on every measure included in the rule.
interpretations.uncertainty_note: Procedural-context row. It explains House floor process and remains excluded from support/opposition and alignment math.
interpretations.interpretation_reason: Candidate uses the official roll-call question and Congress.gov rule-resolution context. It is not a substantive issue-position interpretation.
